title: NeoMME: Stop Paying for a Generative VLM When All You Need Is an Encoder
hook: Document retrievers like ColPali repurpose generative VLMs as encoders and inherit all the overhead. NeoMME is pretrained from scratch as one bidirectional encoder.
key_points: Multimodal retrievers usually bolt a pretrained vision encoder onto a causal LM — generative machinery paying for a non-generative task.
NeoMME is a 260M/800M family: multilingual text and raw image patches in a single bidirectional Transformer encoder.
Pretrained from scratch with a masked discrete-diffusion text objective, conditioned on visible image patches.
Supports a 16,384-token context — enough for up to two 4K UHD images.
NeoMME-Retriever 260M reports 0.523 nDCG@10 on ViDoRe v3, beating all evaluated sub-800M models; the 800M reaches 0.556.
About 2x the page-encoding throughput of ColModernVBERT at matched input size; token pooling plus asymmetric quantization compresses embeddings 255x while keeping over 95% of nDCG@10.
content_html: Visual document retrieval has been riding on borrowed architecture. Models like ColPali take a generative vision-language model — a pretrained vision encoder wired to a causal language model — and repurpose it as an encoder, which means carrying a generative model's parameter and compute overhead for a task that never generates anything. Lac and Wu argue you should just pretrain the encoder you actually want.
extra_html:
How it works

NeoMME is a family of 260M- and 800M-parameter bidirectional encoders that take multilingual text and raw image patches into a single Transformer. Both sizes are pretrained from scratch with a masked discrete-diffusion text objective, conditioned on visible image patches for multimodal examples, and support a 16,384-token context — enough to encode up to two standard 4K UHD images. The authors then fine-tune with jointly trained dense and late-interaction heads to get a retriever.

Why it matters

On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark the authors report NeoMME-Retriever 260M at 0.523 nDCG@10, outperforming all evaluated models strictly below 800M parameters, with the 800M variant at 0.556. At matched 2048x2048 input on an NVIDIA L40S, NeoMME-260M encodes pages at roughly 2x the throughput of ColModernVBERT, and hierarchical token pooling plus asymmetric quantization compresses late-interaction embeddings by 255x while preserving over 95% of baseline nDCG@10 — the storage cost that usually makes late interaction painful. Backbone and retrieval checkpoints are Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, and the model is contributed to Transformers. H Company also published a walkthrough of the design on the Hugging Face blog: https://huggingface.co/blog/Hcompany/neomme

related.title: Multi-Vector Retrieval: One Vector Per Token, Scored Late
related.hook: Squeezing a document into one vector throws away where the match was. Late interaction keeps a vector per token and defers scoring — better recall, 42x the index.

related.title: Training Your Own Late-Interaction Retriever
related.hook: A domain-specific multi-vector retriever took 14.5 hours on one RTX 3090 and beat every zero-shot model tested — including dense retrievers 33 times its size.

flashcards.prompt: What architectural overhead does NeoMME avoid compared with retrievers built on generative VLMs?
flashcards.back_html: The parameter and compute cost of a causal language model plus a separately pretrained vision encoder — machinery for generation that retrieval never uses.

flashcards.prompt: What pretraining objective does NeoMME use?

choices.text: A masked discrete-diffusion text objective, conditioned on visible image patches
Next-token prediction over interleaved image and text tokens
CLIP-style contrastive alignment of image and text towers

flashcards.explanation_html: It is bidirectional and non-generative by design: masked discrete diffusion over text, with image patches supplied as visible conditioning in the same single tower.

flashcards.prompt: Why does 'single-tower' matter for a multimodal encoder?
flashcards.back_html: Text and raw image patches go through one bidirectional Transformer rather than separate pretrained modules stitched together — no import of a generative model's overhead.
